newsitem.title: USA: Fleet unit wins "outstanding" CRA rating.
newsitem.headline: Fleet unit wins "outstanding" CRA rating.

text.p: Fleet Financial Group Inc said its Jersey City, N.J.-based Fleet Bank NA unit received an "outstanding" rating from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) under the Community Reinvestment Act (CRA).
The rating covers Fleet's 360 branches in the New York metropolitan area including New Jersey. The unit includes branches acquired from National Westminster Bank Plc earlier this year.
The "outstanding" rating is the highest CRA category. The rankings reflect a bank's record in meeting credit needs of low and moderate-income neighborhoods.
The rating was issued after an examination that concluded July 25, Fleet said. A spokesman said the unit's previous CRA rating had also been "outstanding."
